newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dow Chem DOW,N invests Dfl 275 mln in Robeco fund.
newsitem.headline: Dow Chem DOW,N invests Dfl 275 mln in Robeco fund.

text.p: The Robeco group of investment funds said on Monday that Dow Financial Services, a unit of U.S. chemicals concern Dow Chemicals, had invested 275 million guilders in its RG Nettorente Fund.
"Dow has made this investment as part of its policy to achieve an international spread of liquidities," Robeco said in a statement.
It said Dow had opted for RG Nettorente Fund because the fund invested exclusively in interest-bearing debt securities issued by first-class debtors.
It said Dow Chemical was investing in RG Nettorente Fund indirectly through a subsidiary of the fund created specially for this purpose.
The Dow Chemical investment would take the fund's total managed capital to 1.8 billion guilders, it said.
